notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable only after the bookmark is saved.
REF-BM-05: No bookmark deletion operation exists.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate saves are prevented and the existing card is highlighted, but editing is not opened automatically.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, note, and hostname, but not the complete URL.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and quoted literals work, but implicit AND such as `rome (#article OR #book)` is rejected.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions are implemented.
REF-BM-21: No action can be applied to the full currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: The user cannot choose a sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is rendered as plain text.
REF-BM-24: A sanitized HTML copy is stored and served, but it is not a self-contained single-file capture and PDF URLs are unsupported.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent; the Done state only represents read status.
REF-BM-27: Neither reversible archive nor permanent delete behavior is implemented.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
